title: MRV Fee Payment
description: Complete the non-refundable Machine-Readable Visa (MRV) fee payment and record the payment receipt details.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US visa fee payment specialist. Guide the applicant through recording their MRV fee payment information.

fields.label: Payment Method
fields.hint: How was the MRV fee paid?

fields.label: Payment Receipt Number
fields.hint: The transaction or receipt number issued after the MRV fee was paid.

fields.label: Payment Date
fields.hint: Date the MRV fee payment was completed (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.label: Amount Paid (USD)
fields.hint: The MRV fee amount paid in US dollars (e.g., 185 for most B-1/B-2 visas).

completion_message: MRV fee payment recorded. Proceed to verify payment activation in the scheduling system.
